name: Interstitial Lung Disease Due to ABCA3 Deficiency

criteria.description: Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in the ABCA3 gene
Progressive respiratory distress and hypoxemia in neonates or infants
High-resolution CT showing diffuse interstitial lung disease with ground-glass opacities and reticular changes
Lung biopsy showing alveolar proteinosis, type II pneumocyte hyperplasia, and interstitial fibrosis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of biallelic ABCA3 pathogenic variants plus compatible clinical and radiologic findings
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Lung biopsy is not always required if genetic and clinical findings are conclusive.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Diffuse interstitial infiltrates on chest imaging in infancy
searchTerms: widespread lung tissue changes on infant chest scans
diffuse interstitial lung patterns in babies
lung imaging showing widespread infiltrates in infancy

rare.symptomName: Extrapulmonary manifestations such as mild hepatomegaly
searchTerms: mildly enlarged liver outside lungs
hepatomegaly as extrapulmonary sign

laboratory: Hypoxemia on arterial blood gas analysis
Elevated lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) in some cases
imaging: High-resolution CT showing diffuse ground-glass opacities, reticular patterns, and interstitial thickening
Chest X-ray with bilateral interstitial infiltrates
other: Lung biopsy demonstrating alveolar proteinosis, type II pneumocyte hyperplasia, and interstitial fibrosis (when performed)

distinguishingFeatures: SP-B deficiency typically presents with neonatal respiratory failure but is caused by mutations in SFTPB gene
Histopathology shows absence of mature surfactant protein B
SP-C deficiency often presents later in infancy or childhood with variable severity
Mutations in SFTPC gene and different histopathologic features
Typically due to surfactant deficiency in premature infants without genetic mutations

redFlags: Severe respiratory distress unresponsive to surfactant therapy
Progressive hypoxemia despite maximal supportive care
Early onset interstitial lung disease in neonates or infants
